Teacher And Learning Resources.notes: Corpus-observed 7-value Use Case bundle for teaching-resource content — apply it in full as one atomic decision, don't cherry-pick the subset that seems to fit this particular item. This is every Use Case value except the admin/monitoring cluster (`Managing Education Organisation Policies And Obligations`, `Monitoring School Performance`, `Monitoring Pupil Behaviour & Wellbeing`, `Managing School Policies And Obligations`, `Managing Finacial And Funding Matters`) and `Assessment And Feedback`.

Past Papers.notes: Test/mark-scheme items: `content_type_bundle` means Content Type itself is corpus-observed as multi-valued here — emit all three values together, not just `Past Papers` alone. Use Case takes the same 7-value bundle as `Teacher And Learning Resources`.

theme_default.notes: The Thematic Category/Use Case Theme pair for every Content Type that has no `use_case_bundles` entry above and doesn't match one of thematic-and-use-case.md's named exceptions — roughly three-quarters of the corpus (`Guidance`, `Pedagogical Guidance`/`Pedagogical/Teaching Guidance`, `Learning Objectives`, `National Curriculum`, `Teacher Generated Content`, and more). Apply this pair as the default read on both keys, not a from-scratch judgement call each time — only deviate where thematic-and-use-case.md's exceptions fire.

sparse_or_empty_when: the item is a subject/inspection *report* — a review of how a subject or the school system is being taught/performing/inspected across many schools, not a resource for one classroom — even when Content Type itself reads as teaching-flavoured (e.g. `Teacher Generated Content` used for a subject report)
the item is a privacy notice, consent form, or other compliance/data-protection/administrative-process document
Content Type is `Administrative Guidance` or `Quality Assurance`
use_case_default_pool.notes: Use for every Content Type *without* a literal `use_case_bundles` entry (that map stays reserved for its two exact, corpus-verified atomic bundles — don't pattern-match it onto lookalikes). Default is dense, not sparse: pick the 2-7 values from `pool` that this specific item is actually true of — don't leave the field empty just because Content Type lacks a `use_case_bundles` entry, and don't import the whole pool wholesale either, that's reserved for the literal bundle matches. Fall to sparse/empty only when one of `sparse_or_empty_when` fires — that list is short and shape-based (what the document is *for*), not a Content Type lookup.
